admission.justification: Bounded pressure eviction against one census is proved by the named passing budget cases; single-file member of the family.

applicability: Every log folder the server writes.
conditions: Transcript root 256 MiB and one enclosure 64 MiB when absent (both configurable), one detail 8 MiB fixed.
Eviction removes whole oldest days first against one coherent census; only confirmed reclaimed bytes leave it.
exclusions: Enclosure age pruning, which does not exist — the budget is the only pre-cleanup removal.
The stated census/listing margin between concurrent writers.
statement: The transcript root (256MiB when absent), one enclosure (64MiB when absent) and one detail (8MiB, fixed) bound every folder, with oldest-first whole-day eviction against one coherent census; only confirmed reclaimed bytes leave the census and successful cached-day removal is never re-walked.
